items.description: Floor cleaning, connection check, skirting replacement utility room and hallway
items.rationale: Escape of water from washing machine hose (2.4.2) is covered; cleaning of affected surfaces (7.1.7h), source check (7.1.7e) and replacement of damaged skirting (building component) are repair costs. Moderate market price for a combined flat rate.

items.description: Moisture measurement and drying utility room and hallway incl. dryer
items.rationale: 7.1.7(b) covers moisture measurement and drying of affected rooms incl. equipment hire (7.1.7e); both rooms were wetted. Market price for a few days drying.

items.description: Assessment and drying of framed decorative print
items.rationale: Contents not insured under buildings cover (4.3d); 5.2.6 applies only to items of particular value (art, antiques), not a mass-produced poster print in a pine frame, so excluded.
